hints.title: Ascending Value Order
hints.text: Sort the distinct cell values in ascending order to resolve transitions safely.

hints.title: Row and Column Maxima
hints.text: Maintain the maximum path length reachable across each individual row and column.

hints.title: Simultaneous Updates
hints.text: Calculate the new length for all cells with identical values before updating row and column maxima.

hints.title: Value-Grouped Iteration

complexity.notes: Grouping by distinct value and sorting determines safe DAG ordering.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Direct graph traversal between all smaller and larger cells builds quadratic edges per row and column.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Row and column maximum vectors compress state lookups to O(1).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Resolves equal-value updates simultaneously to enforce strictly increasing paths.
